rows.jyutping: jung6 tai2 m4 hei2 jan4 ge3 taai3 dou6
rows.note: This is the all-purpose colloquial choice for doing or saying something in a scornful, disrespectful manner.

example.english: They always speak to the new colleague contemptuously.
example.traditional: 佢成日用睇唔起人嘅態度同新同事講嘢。
example.jyutping: keoi5 seng4 jat6 jung6 tai2 m4 hei2 jan4 ge3 taai3 dou6 tung4 san1 tung4 si6 gong2 je5
